title: Switching an output on for one second
body_md: An output can be switched on for one second by text message. Pro-finder switches it accordingly and sends a status report.
next_context: Switching for a freely selectable time follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 23: equivalent in substance, including the one second. Neither version names a tolerance or a repeat lock-out.
